name: Guacamole
steps: In a medium bowl, combine the 1 cup mashed avocados with the 1/3 cup diced tomatoes, 1/3 cup shredded cheddar.
Stir in the 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder, 1 teaspoon salt, 4 tablespoons hot sauce until well blended. Taste and adjust seasoning.
Cover and refrigerate at least 30 minutes so the flavors meld.
Serve chilled with 24 for serving tortilla chip.

name: Classic Hummus
steps: In a medium bowl, combine the 1 1/4 cups mashed chickpeas with the 1/2 cup crumbled bacon, 2/3 cup diced tomatoes.
Stir in the 2 teaspoons garlic powder, 1 teaspoon salt until well blended. Taste and adjust seasoning.
Cover and refrigerate at least 30 minutes so the flavors meld.
Serve chilled with 14 for serving cracker.

name: Deviled Eggs
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F. Line a baking sheet with parchment.
Arrange the 22 chicken wings on the sheet and brush lightly with 4 tablespoons olive oil.
Spoon the 1 1/2 cups cheese and herb mixture into each, then sprinkle with 1/4 teaspoon salt, 1/2 teaspoon Italian seasoning.
Bake 20 minutes, until golden and cooked through. Cool 5 minutes and serve warm.

name: Bruschetta
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Line a baking sheet with parchment.
Arrange the 13 mini bell peppers on the sheet and brush lightly with 4 tablespoons olive oil.
Spoon the 1 cup seasoned ground meat into each, then sprinkle with 2 teaspoons salt, 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder.
Bake 12 minutes, until golden and cooked through. Cool 5 minutes and serve warm.

name: Chicken Noodle Soup
steps: Heat the 2 tablespoons butter in a large pot over medium heat. Add the diced yellow onion, minced garlic, diced carrots and cook, stirring often, until softened, about 5 minutes.
Pour in the 4 cups beef broth and add the 1 cup diced chicken breast, 2/3 cup red lentils. Bring to a boil over high heat.
Reduce the heat to low, cover partially, and simmer 40 minutes, until everything is tender.
Remove any bay leaf. Season with the 1/4 teaspoon salt, 1/2 teaspoon black pepper, 1 teaspoon dried thyme, tasting and adjusting as you go.
Ladle into warm bowls, top with 2 tablespoons cilantro, and serve hot.

name: Tomato Soup
steps: Heat the 2 tablespoons butter in a large pot over medium heat. Add the diced sweet onion, minced garlic and cook, stirring often, until softened, about 5 minutes.
Pour in the 4 cups beef broth and add the 1 1/2 cups diced tomatoes. Bring to a boil over high heat.
Reduce the heat to low, cover partially, and simmer 20 minutes, until everything is tender.
Remove any bay leaf. Season with the 1/4 teaspoon salt, 1/2 teaspoon black pepper, 1/4 teaspoon dried thyme, tasting and adjusting as you go.
Ladle into warm bowls, top with 1 tablespoon cilantro, and serve hot.

name: Beef Stew
steps: Heat the 1 tablespoon vegetable oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the diced yellow onion, minced garlic and cook, stirring often, until softened, about 5 minutes.
Pour in the 4 cups vegetable broth and add the 1 3/4 cups beef stew meat, 2/3 cup kidney beans. Bring to a boil over high heat.
Reduce the heat to low, cover partially, and simmer 30 minutes, until everything is tender.
Remove any bay leaf. Season with the 1/4 teaspoon salt, 2 teaspoons black pepper, 2 teaspoons dried thyme, tasting and adjusting as you go.
Ladle into warm bowls, top with 4 tablespoons cilantro, and serve hot.

name: Caesar Salad
steps: Wash and dry the 4 cups chopped romaine and place in a large salad bowl.
Add the 2/3 cup diced bell pepper, 1/4 cup cherry tomatoes, 3/4 cup diced cucumber, 3/4 cup chickpeas.
In a small jar, shake together the 1 tablespoon olive oil, 2 tablespoons lemon juice, and 1/4 teaspoon Dijon mustard, 1/4 teaspoon honey, 1/2 teaspoon salt until emulsified.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss gently until everything is lightly coated. Serve right away.

name: Greek Salad
steps: Wash and dry the 4 cups chopped romaine and place in a large salad bowl.
Add the 2/3 cup chopped walnuts, 1/3 cup sliced strawberries, 1 cup sliced strawberries.
In a small jar, shake together the 1/2 tablespoon olive oil, 3 tablespoons balsamic vinegar, and 1/2 teaspoon Dijon mustard, 1/4 teaspoon honey, 1/2 teaspoon salt until emulsified.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss gently until everything is lightly coated. Serve right away.

name: Roast Chicken
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Pat the 1 pound whole chicken dry with paper towels.
Rub all over with 2 tablespoons olive oil and season generously with 1 teaspoon salt, 1/4 teaspoon black pepper, 2 teaspoons dried rosemary.
Scatter the 2 1/2 cups carrots around the pan. Roast 45 minutes, until cooked through and the juices run clear.
Rest 10 minutes before slicing so the juices settle. Serve warm.

Rub all over with 3 tablespoons olive oil and season generously with 2 teaspoons salt, 2 teaspoons black pepper, 1 teaspoon dried rosemary.
Roast 75 minutes, until cooked through and the juices run clear.
Rest 10 minutes before slicing so the juices settle. Serve warm.

name: Spaghetti Bolognese
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook the 16 ounces spaghetti until al dente; reserve 1/2 cup pasta water, then drain.

Meanwhile, heat the 3 tablespoons olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the 4 cloves minced garlic and cook 1 minute. Add the 1 1/2 cups Italian sausage and cook until browned, breaking it up.
Stir in the 2 1/2 cups marinara sauce and simmer 8 minutes, loosening with pasta water as needed.
Toss the pasta with the sauce, top with 1/3 cup grated Parmesan, and serve immediately.

steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook the 16 ounces lasagna noodles until al dente; reserve 1/2 cup pasta water, then drain.
Meanwhile, heat the 2 tablespoons olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the 3 cloves minced garlic and cook 1 minute. Add the 3/4 cup white beans and cook until browned, breaking it up.
Stir in the 1 3/4 cups Alfredo sauce and simmer 8 minutes, loosening with pasta water as needed.
Toss the pasta with the sauce, top with 2/3 cup ricotta, and serve immediately.

steps: Pat the 1/2 pounds shrimp, peeled dry and season both sides with 1/4 teaspoon salt, 2 teaspoons black pepper, 1 teaspoon paprika.
Heat the 4 tablespoons olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Cook the fish 12 minutes, turning once, until opaque and flakes easily.
Squeeze 1 cut into wedges lemon over the top, sprinkle with 1/2 tablespoon chopped parsley, and serve at once.

Toss the 3/4 pounds green beans with 2 tablespoons olive oil and 1/2 teaspoon salt, 1/2 teaspoon black pepper, 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar until evenly coated.
Spread in a single layer and roast 20 minutes, turning once, until tender and browned at the edges.
Sprinkle with 3 tablespoons grated Parmesan and serve warm right away.

name: Rice Pilaf
steps: Melt the 2 tablespoons butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Add the 1 minced shallot and cook 2 minutes.
Stir in the 1 1/4 cups couscous to coat, then add the 2 cups water and 1/4 teaspoon salt. Bring to a boil.
Cover, reduce to low, and cook 18 minutes without lifting the lid.
Remove from heat, rest 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork. Serve warm.

name: Banana Bread
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F. Grease a 9x5-inch loaf pan.
Whisk together the 1 3/4 cups all-purpose flour, 1/2 teaspoon baking soda, and 1/4 teaspoon salt in a large bowl.
In another bowl, whisk the 1 cup sugar, 2 eggs, 1 1/2 cups mashed ripe bananas until smooth.
Pour wet into dry and stir just until combined — a few lumps are fine. Fold in the 3/4 cup shredded zucchini.
Bake 60 minutes, until a toothpick in the center comes out clean. Cool 10 minutes, then turn out.

steps: Mix the 2 cups all-purpose flour, 3/4 cup plain yogurt, 4 tablespoons olive oil, and 1/2 teaspoon salt into a soft dough; knead 3 minutes and rest 15.
Divide into 6 balls and roll each thin.
Cook in a hot dry skillet 2 minutes per side until puffed and spotted.
Wrap in a clean towel and serve warm.

name: Dinner Rolls
steps: Stir the 2 teaspoons active dry yeast and 1 tablespoon sugar into the 1 cup warm water; let stand 5–10 minutes until foamy.
Add the 4 cups bread flour, 1 1/2 teaspoons salt, and 3 tablespoons olive oil. Knead 8–10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Cover and rise in a warm spot about 1 hour, until doubled.
Punch down, shape as desired, and rise 30 minutes more.
Bake at 375°F for 25 minutes until deep golden and hollow-sounding when tapped. Cool on a rack.

name: Chocolate Chip Cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F. Line baking sheets with parchment.
Beat the 3/4 cup butter, softened with the 3/4 cup brown sugar and 1/4 cup granulated sugar until creamy, about 2 minutes.
Beat in the 2 eggs, 1 teaspoon vanilla extract.
Stir in the 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour, 1 teaspoon baking soda, 1 teaspoon salt just until combined, then fold in the 3/4 cup raisins.
Scoop rounded tablespoons 2 inches apart. Bake 12 minutes until edges are golden. Cool on the sheet 5 minutes.

name: Vanilla Cake
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F. Grease and flour two 8-inch round pans.
Whisk the 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour, 1 cup granulated sugar, 2 teaspoons baking powder, and 1 teaspoon salt in a large bowl.
Add the 2 eggs, 3/4 cup milk, 1/2 cup vegetable oil, 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract and beat 2 minutes until smooth. Fold in the 1/2 cup mashed banana.
Divide between pans and bake 28 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool 10 minutes in pans, then turn out and cool completely before frosting.

name: Apple Pie
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F. Fit the 1 store-bought or homemade pie crust into a 9-inch pie plate.
Toss the 1 3/4 cups cherry pie filling with the 1 cup sugar and 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon, then beat in the 3 eggs.
Pour into the crust and smooth the top.
Bake 40 minutes until the filling is set and the crust is golden. Cool at least 2 hours before slicing.
